records.title: A Decade of Evidence of Trend Following Investing in Cryptocurrencies
records.claim: Crypto trend-following can exhibit persistent walk-forward opportunity; use trend as an alpha family rather than assuming mean reversion.

records.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction
records.claim: Trend following benefits from volatility-aware trailing risk, adaptive asset selection and asymmetric long/short allocation.

records.title: Machine Learning-Based Bitcoin Trading Under Transaction Costs: Evidence From Walk-Forward Forecasting
records.claim: Naive signals can fail after costs; trade only when expected edge clears a cost-derived hurdle to reduce turnover.

records.title: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets
records.claim: Volume-profile context and momentum confirmation can structure selective mean reversion, while tight stops can be economically invalid once costs consume risk budget.

records.title: Strategy 432 BTC - Donchian Breakout Continuation

records.title: BTC Trend Strategy V2 (Fixed + ADX Working)

records.title: Trend Pulse OBV

records.title: JonnyBtc Daily Pullback Strategy (Volume + ADX)

records.title: r/algotrading: live strategy discussion

records.title: r/algotrading: Do technical analysis work?
